    // The shape sampled at a warped position: bending, twisting, tiling, and
    // instancing are all domain warps. Exact when f is a rigid motion, and a lower
    // bound when f is a contraction. Any f that STRETCHES — a twist, a bend, a
    // non-uniform scale — makes the result exceed the true distance, which is not
    // a bound at all and tunnels a sphere tracer; divide by f's Lipschitz constant
    // to recover a lower bound.
    MapDomain(self: FunctionSdf3D, f: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): FunctionSdf3D
        => FunctionSdf3D(p => self.Eval(f(p)));
